name: Limeira

queries.query: Limeira Brazil official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry public viewer API
queries.result: Found the official Prefeitura de Limeira Limeira Geo announcement and access page, identifying a public municipal geoprocessing platform with lots and other georeferenced information. The viewer's GeoPixel configuration exposed public WMS/WFS endpoints.

queries.query: Limeira mapa cadastral parcelas prefeitura geoprocessamento cadastro imobiliário
queries.result: A busca oficial encontrou o Limeira Geo da Prefeitura, o Setor de Cadastro Imobiliário da Secretaria de Urbanismo, and the municipal cadastral certificate route. Limeira Geo's public GeoServer WFS returned bounded parcel polygons; the certificate and consultation routes were not used for personal or unsafe data.

registryEvidence.custodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Limeira, Secretaria de Urbanismo, Setor de Cadastro Imobiliário / Divisão de Georreferenciamento e Topografia
registryEvidence.basis: First-party municipal pages identify Limeira Geo as a public municipal geoprocessing platform with lots and identify the municipal cadastral custodian. The public WFS is served by the Limeira GeoPixel municipal host.

officialSources.observation: Municipal announcement says Limeira Geo is publicly available and includes lots, roads, public areas, imagery, and zoning information.
Municipal department page identifies the Setor de Cadastro Imobiliário and georeferencing/topography division.
Official access page links the public Limeira Geo platform and user manual; page text requires JavaScript in the fetched response.

requests.outcome: Cloudflare 502/error page in direct fetch; not treated as absence.
Fetched current public consultation HTML; it exposes a login/inscription form and was not submitted.
Inspected current configuration: municipal GeoPixel WMS endpoint, EPSG:31983 local setting, and REST paths; no credentials or tokens used.
Public WMS capabilities returned Limeira layers including lote_test_new presentation layer and EPSG:3857/4326 support.
Public WFS capabilities returned limeira:lote_test and other municipal feature types; service advertises application/json output.
Schema exposes native id (long), gid, codigo, and geom plus many source attributes. Only id and geom were retained.
Bounded anonymous response returned 783 matching features and three Polygon features in EPSG:4326. Retained sample uses native id values 196425, 117147, and 137777 only.

source: Prefeitura de Limeira GeoPixel GeoServer WFS limeira:lote_test

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Limeira municipal Limeira Geo cadastral/lote layers.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A bounded WFS request around the preserved WUP point returned three parcel polygons; this is local sample evidence, not a complete citywide extract.

remainingUncertainty: The public WFS route and three safe native identities are verified, but the sample is bounded, update cadence and complete citywide coverage are unverified, and the main Limeira Geo page returned a Cloudflare error in direct fetch. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; nearby geometry was not treated as an exact-point hit or absence test.
